scope: Envelope models for U2301 (W25Q128JW WSON-8 8x6) and U1710 (TPS23730 RMT VQFN). C1723/C1729 moved to stock CP_Elec footprints with stock models, J1201 to a stock USB-C footprint with its stock model. Remaining holds need vendor CAD (RJ45, magnetics, SIM, Q1706, WE-SL5) or are bare-copper / mechanical footprints. Vendor STEPs (Amphenol RJE49, Pulse HX4110NL, Wurth 744272251) fitted to their footprints by matching lead/pin feet to pad centres; FDMS86252 and the Molex nano-SIM are envelopes measured from download-only vendor CAD.

attached.source:
W25Q128JWEIQ WSON-8 8x6 (Winbond package code E, same outline as the stock KiCad
WSON-8-1EP_8x6mm_P1.27mm_EP3.4x4.3mm land): D 8.00 (x) x E 6.00 (y) nominal, A 0.80 max; terminals
and the 3.4 x 4.3 exposed pad modelled at the footprint's own copper shrunk 0.1 per side. Pin 1 top-left.

TPS23730 RMT0045A VQFN-45: 5.00 (x) x 7.00 (y) nominal per the TI PMP22477 footprint's body outline,
A 1.00 max (TI VQFN family); terminals and the two thermal pads at the footprint copper shrunk 0.05 per
side. Pin 1 top-left (-2.4, -2.6).

Amphenol RJE49-188-1X01 Rev T1 vendor STEP (reference/vendor-3d/amphenol-rje49-188-1x01-3d.zip, family file
covering RJE491881401). Native Z is height (top +1.01, standoffs -11.95, pin tips -14.95). Fitted to the
footprint: all 10 pin tips land on the pad centres within 0.001 mm with no rotation; seating on the standoffs.
Baked: translate (42.9, -17.031, 11.95).

Pulse HX4110NL vendor STEP (reference/vendor-3d/pulse-hx4110nl-3d.zip). Native X length, Y height (lead feet at
-0.121), Z width. Map X = x, Y = -z, Z = y; the 24 lead feet land on the pad centres within 0.03 mm and the
pin-1 dot sits next to pad 1 (the 180-degree fit puts it at pad 13). Baked translate (2.1054, 0.529, 0.121).

Wurth 744272251 (WE-SL5) rev1 vendor STEP (reference/vendor-3d/wurth-744272251-rev1-3d.zip). Native frame is
KiCad's (Z up, centred); the terminal bottoms sit 0.3 below the body at Z=-0.3 and land on the stock
L_CommonModeChoke_Wuerth_WE-SL5 pads (rms 0.16 mm). Baked translate (0, 0, 0.3).

FDMS86252 Power56 (Q1706): envelope measured from the onsemi/SnapMagic STEP (not redistributable, so not
stored): body 5.80 (x) x 4.90 (y), top 1.10, standoff 0.05; terminals and drain tab at the footprint copper
shrunk 0.05. Native fit put pin 1's marker next to pad 1 at (-2.67, -1.905).

remaining_holds.blocker: Bare copper pads and leg holes for a Tag-Connect TC2030-IDC cable; no component is fitted, so there is nothing to model.
Plated M2 hold-down for the M.2 card; the standoff/screw is mechanical hardware, not a fitted component.
